# Typamine

> The ultimate typographic web application. A modern, high-performance platform to discover, test, convert, discover, and download fonts, font pairings, and web typography tools.

Full content index available at: https://typamine.com/llms-full.txt

## Primary Sections

- [Free Fonts Catalog](https://typamine.com/ingredients): Comprehensive directory of free typefaces with live specimen previews, licensing info, variable font details, and direct downloads.
- [Font Pairings](https://typamine.com/prescriptions): Expert heading + body font combinations with real copy previews and design notes.
- [Font Formulas](https://typamine.com/formulas): Curated and algorithmic font collections grouped by mood, tag, category, and use-case.
- [Typography Pills](https://typamine.com/pills): Educational articles, web typography guides, and design tips.
- [Vintage Archive](https://typamine.com/archive): Historical type specimens and vintage lettering references.
- [Font Designers & Foundries](https://typamine.com/author): Profiles of type designers and foundries behind the catalog.

## Web Typography Tools (/labs)

- [Font Converter](https://typamine.com/labs/font-converter): Client-side WebAssembly font format converter (WOFF2, TTF, OTF, WOFF).
- [@font-face Generator](https://typamine.com/labs/font-face-generator): Generates cross-browser CSS @font-face rules and snippet downloads.
- [Tailwind Config Generator](https://typamine.com/labs/tailwind-generator): Generates custom tailwind.config.js font-family and typography theme extensions.
- [WCAG Contrast Checker](https://typamine.com/labs/wcag): Real-time web accessibility color contrast analyzer meeting WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA compliance.
